transform.sql:
SELECT
  dealership_location,
  trunc(sale_date, 'MM') AS sale_month,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  SUM(price) AS total_sales_value,
  AVG(price) AS average_sale_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS unique_customers
FROM sales_cars_silver
GROUP BY dealership_location, trunc(sale_date, 'MM')
